boundary: Stage 24B projects trained 40-Element readout directions through static output embeddings. It does not prove exact neurons, SAE-disentangled features, raw CAS-symbol understanding, or that the model would generate the listed tokens in free-form decoding.
plain_english_read: This report measures whether original TKS 40-Element readout directions have class-specific token signatures in Pythia-160M's output embedding space. It tests domain and Noetic token geometry directly, rather than relying on the weaker Foundation Register axis.
